verdict.rationale: Google's docs say Titan keys ship in USB-A/NFC and USB-C/NFC form factors and work with compatible Android and iOS devices over NFC. They specifically list iPhones on iOS 13.3+ and sign-in on Android through Google apps or Chrome. One hands-on report found no non-Google Android software that could talk to the keys, which suggests limited third-party app and browser coverage but does not contradict the documented NFC capability. Missing for 10: evidence of NFC use with third-party mobile apps and non-Chrome browsers, and independent hands-on confirmation of NFC tap on phones.
